notes.title: Update! 3 new levels are available for free!
notes.content:
Maria, a woman who plays in the theater, does not get the role she wanted ... How will this turn out for her and the other actress? We made this 3-level add-on for free and also fixed a lot of bugs. [b] Thank you for being with us! [/ b]

[list]
[*] Immerse yourself in the dreams of a girl dreaming of fame.
[*] Explore 3 new levels.
[*] Several important bugs have been fixed.
[/ list]

notes.title: Update! Added minor bug fixes and Portuguese translation.
notes.content: We added the Portuguese language to the game. Thiago "Thitz" Mania helped make the translation. Thanks to him! We will be glad to see reviews in this beautiful language. Also, minor bugs with finding items were fixed.
